title: How To Play Trouble In Terrorist Town (TTT) - Traitor Weapons
description:
How to Play TTT is a new series where I go through everything you need to know to get better at Trouble In Terrorist Town, including weapons, maps, karma, and even strategies. If you have any questions please ask them in the comment section down below!

"Trouble in Terrorist Town (TTT) is a gamemode included with Garry's Mod. The game is about a group of "terrorists" who have traitors among them, out to kill everyone who's not a traitor.

A small number of players is selected as Traitors, who have to kill all the Innocent players (ie. the rest of the players). Those innocents know they are in the majority, but they do not know who is Traitor and who is not.

The Traitors must use the element of surprise and their special equipment, if they are to succeed. The Innocent just have to survive, which means finding out who the Traitors are and killing them before they kill you. Of course everyone is holding a big gun, and everyone looks suspicious...

For the Innocent, knowledge is power: who is acting strangely? Who can be linked to evidence found on corpses? Who is still alive, even?"
-http://ttt.badking.net/

If you guys enjoyed this video please give it a Like and Comment with your thoughts. It takes two seconds and REALLY helps me out!

And if you haven't yet, Subscribe for more!

title: Beautiful Clouds Timelapse at Khardung Village - Vlog 44 | Fakkad Vlogs | #leh #khardung #ladakh
description:
Beautiful Clouds Timelapse at Khardung Village - Vlog 44 | Fakkad Vlogs | 18 Aug 2023 | Leh Ladakh Tour 2023 | Video 223  #leh #ladakh #khardung

Hello, and Warm Greetings to All Travel Enthusiasts!

Welcome to Fakkad Vlogs, your go-to YouTube channel for extraordinary travel experiences. We are thrilled to share our latest adventure - a captivating 8-day tour of Leh Ladakh in August 2023. This journey is not just a travelogue; it explores culture, nature, and the spirit of adventure that Leh Ladakh embodies.

Leh Ladakh: A Land of High Passes and Mystic Beauty

Our journey began in the heart of Leh City, where traditional and modern life intertwines. We strolled through the bustling Leh Main Bazaar, a vibrant local culture and commerce hub. Our visit to the Shanti Stupa offered spiritual solace and panoramic city views.

Discovering Ancient Monasteries and Breathtaking Landscapes

The tour took us to the ancient Lamayuru Monastery, a site of serene spirituality set against stark, beautiful landscapes. We captured the confluence of the Indus and Zanskar rivers at Sangam View Point, a sight to behold. The mysterious Magnetic Hills left us in awe, challenging the very laws of physics.

Adventure and Thrills at Every Turn

For adrenaline seekers, the Banjee Zumping Point provided an exhilarating experience. We then unwound in the quaint Chilling Village, a perfect retreat for nature lovers. The journey to Kahdung La Top and Khardong Village was a test of endurance and offered some of the region's most spectacular views.

The Enchanting Nubra Valley and Beyond

Our adventure continued to the mesmerizing Nubra Valley, a high-altitude desert known for its Hunder Sand Dunes. We explored Diskit and the iconic Diskit Gompa, immersing ourselves in the region's rich Buddhist heritage. The journey through Shyok River, Agham, Durbuk, and Tangtse revealed harsh and beautiful landscapes.

The Jewel of Ladakh: Pangong Lake

A highlight of our trip was the breathtaking Pangong Lake View. The serene beauty of Spangmik and the challenging Chang La Pass were experiences that will stay with us forever. Our journey through Zingral, Sakti, Chemrey, Karu, Thiksey, and Shey showcased the diverse beauty of Ladakh.

Join Us on This Incredible Journey

We invite you to join us on this incredible journey through our videos on the YouTube channel of our Fakkad Vlogs. Experience the beauty, culture, and adventure of Leh Ladakh as we bring you along on our unforgettable tour. Don't forget to like, share, and subscribe for more exciting travel content!

A esposa e os filhos da vítima também estavam na residência mas não foram feridos. O latrocínio ocorreu em Itapoá, no Litoral Norte do estado.

title: Salman Rushdie’s attacker speaks out after 25-year prison sentence
description:
The man convicted of trying to kill Salman Rushdie has been sentenced to 25 years in prison for launching a frenzied knife attack on the author.

A New York jury deliberated for less than two hours before convicting Hadi Matar, 27, of second-degree attempted murder back in February. 

British-American author Rushdie was blinded in one eye in the harrowing attack in August 2022. The attacker was also found guilty of assault for injuring Henry Reese, who was onstage with Rushdie and was about to interview the author.

Rushdie, 77, did not return to the Chautauqua County courtroom in western New York for his assailant's sentencing Friday, but submitted a victim impact statement.

Matar received the maximum 25-year sentence for the attempted murder of Rushdie and seven years for wounding Reese, who sustained a gash above his left eye that required stitches.

transcript: This man hid his personal savings. By sticking them to his hat. He was absolutely certain his wife would never find out. But while he was out taking some photos , his wife asked him to change his pose . And take off his hat. Thinking the money was stuck securely, he took off the hat . Carelessly, but the money wasn't well-fastened, so his wife noticed it immediately. Surprisingly, she wasn't angry but gestured for him to come closer. Later, the man had a new idea. He hid the money inside some clothes his wife hadn't worn in a long time. As soon as he finished, he heard his wife returning home. In a state of panic , he jumped inside a storage box. But he didn't expect that his wife intended to donate those old clothes. The result was that the man ended up being donated along with the clothes. When his wife contacted him later, he had to lie. Claiming he was on a business trip in the mountains. After returning, he devised another plan, taking advantage of the changing seasons to hide his money inside the air conditioner during winter. Confident his wife would never turn it on. But shortly after, some relatives arrived. To visit and felt the room was getting too warm, so they suggested turning on the AC. As he was about to reach for the remote , he suddenly remembered the money hidden inside. In a panic, he shouted, claiming there was no AC in the house. But his cousin pointed to the truth and exposed his lie . The man tried to change his story, claiming the device was broken, but his cousin managed to turn it on anyway. The man felt very embarrassed and claimed the remote was missing, but his cousin produced it immediately. Then, at the height of his anger and frustration, the man stomped on the remote. His wife rushed into the room after hearing the noise. And scolded him for his stinginess. Then she carelessly pressed. The power button, and the hidden money went flying everywhere. With no other options left, he turned to a close friend for advice. The friend revealed where he hides his own money. And suggested he do the same thing. At that moment, his wife entered and saw everything. In a desperate attempt as a last resort , he grabbed the leg of a mannequin. And ran quickly toward his house.

description:
Join us on an incredible journey through Thailand, where we explore places that seem almost too surreal to be real! From the breathtaking views of Phang Nga cliffs to the tranquil temples scattered across Koh Samui, this adventure will take you through some of the most stunning cultural gems in the world. Experience the thrill of Phang Nga kayaking as we navigate through its mesmerizing waters, and don’t miss the magical sunsets on Phi Phi Island.

In this video, we delve into the hidden gems of Thailand, revealing cultural hotspots like Bangkok's vibrant nightlife and the serene temple trails that are home to thousands of breathtaking temples. Hop on a tuk tuk for an exciting tour of Bangkok's cultural sites and embark on unforgettable adventures on Phi Phi Island.

title: How To Work With Local Artists To Create Custom Art ~ Feat. Kayli Magdaleno
description:
We recently commissioned a local artist, Kayli Magdaleno, to create custom artwork for our home and couldn't be happier with the result.  In this video I walk you through the process and show you the final piece.

Thanks so much for watching my channel, I really appreciate it. Please Subscribe if you like what you're seeing, I'd love to have you be part of our Subscriber family. To book a personal consultation, shopping expedition or public speaking appearance please contact me at thedressupmom@gmail.com.  Until next time, have fun & dress it up a little! ~ Rajka Hayden, The Dress Up Mom

~ Featured This Episode ~

Kayli Magdaleno - Resin artist based in San Diego.  Reach her on  Instagram @kaymagart or via phone at 619-820-4277.

~ Social Media ~

My Channel - http://tinyurl.com/thedressupmom
Facebook - http://facebook.com/thedressupmom
Instagram - http://instagram.com/thedressupmom
Pinterest - http://pinterest.com/thedressupmom
Twitter - https://twitter.com/thedressupmom

Website - http://thedressupmom.com
Email - thedressupmom@gmail.com
transcript:
Intro [Music] Welcome to The Dress Up Mom. [Music] Hello. Today I am so excited because we are commissioning
some custom art work for our home. We’re going to get a couple of new pieces
made and the artist is coming to our house today to take a look around and see what we
do. We’re going to take you through this whole
process: what inspires her, how she’s going to do it and then show you sort of the before
and after of what we come up with. But first, thank you so much for watching,
I really appreciate it. If you are a regular viewer and subscriber,
I love you, thank you so much, it means the world to me. If you haven’t subscribed and you like what
you’re seeing, please do. It’s the button, it’s just here below,
it means the world to me, trying to grow the channel. We’re also on all the social media outlets,
Instagram, Facebook, Twitter @thedressupmom #thedressupmom, and you can check us out there
too. Here is the room that we are going to be working
in. Room Tour So, this is what it currently looks like. If you were watching any of my videos about
a year ago, we really went through and did a bunch of new things in here and spruced
things up. So, here are the colors. We’ve also have gotten a couple of new things,
like this was in my parent’s house, I really like it, but it adds kind of a different color
scheme. Also, from my parent’s house, recently we
went through and cleaned a bunch of that out, we have little bowls and things like that. We want to replace this piece. Now I really like them, they’re very cool,
but I think the colors aren’t quite right. This is waves at a sunset, I’m going to
incorporate them in a different part of the house. But, I’m thinking that maybe a little bit
more color in here would be good. So, Kayli’s here, I’m going to go down
and get here. Interview Rajka: Here we are with the lovely and very
talented Kayli Magdaleno, the one I’ve been telling you about. I’m so excited about this Kayli. Kayli: I’m excited as well. Rajka: I’m really excited. So, I’ll tell you the back story. I met Kayli, she was my Yoga teacher for a
couple of years. I actually loved, loved, loved, loved her
classes. It was Monday, starting a week off with my
Kayli fix, it was great. But, I had no idea that Kayli was an artist
and then she decided to make a lifestyle change and spend more time working on her art, so
stopped teaching Yoga. I started following her on Instagram and her
art is gorgeous. Kayli: Thank you. Rajka: I knew that I would have to have some
of Kayli and a bit of your soul in our space. Kayli: Oh, I love that. I love that. Rajka: So, tell me about like your process. What motivates you, how you got into this. Kayli: Well, I’ve always had a creative
side. I grew up with a creative side both of my
parents and I never found niche. And then I started watching YouTube videos,
honestly. Rajka: This is how you learned how to paint? Kayli: Yes. Rajka: No way. Kayli: Yes. Rajka: Oh my God, I didn’t even know that. Kayli: I saw, there was a piece that I really
loved, and I had to figure out how they did it because I could tell that it wasn’t just
acrylic or ink, there was more to it. There was depth, it was shiny, it was great. And so, I just started YouTubing it. Rajka: No way. Kayli: And then I taught myself and I’m
a trial and error leaning, so it’s totally been a wild ride. But, yeah, I love it. Rajka: Oh my gosh, that’s great. So, do you remember who it was that you were
watching on YouTube so we can get a shout out? Kayli: I don’t. I wish I did. Rajka: Oh, that’s all right. That’s okay. Kayli: I don’t remember. Rajka: YouTube really is amazing. As a creative outlet for creators, as well
as for people. I had no idea on that. So, tell everybody, because I haven’t shown
them what it is that you do, but what is it that you do? What is your art? Kayli: So, it’s - my medium is epoxy resin,
so it’s what you use to finish surfboards. So, it gives that shiny, kind of glassy look
to it and then you just mix paint in it. Rajka: Let people know too, you’re an avid
surfer. Kayli: Avid surfer, love the water. Rajka: Everyday pretty much? Kayli: Yeah. Yes, almost every day. The water is hands down my inspiration. Nature in general, but mostly the water just
because there’s so much depth to her and she teaches me so much on a day to day basis
on just how to handle her and then how to like to transcend into the real world. I just love using her colors and she’s totally
my inspiration. Rajka: Great. Kayli: The water through and through. Rajka: And I love that too. I’ve always been -- it gives me energy. I’m not as avid a surfer, I started a little
later in life, but I love it too. Every time I come back out, it’s a whole
different person, right? It’s great, right? Kayli: And even just being around her. There’s something about her that’s special. Rajka: I agree. So, another reason, as you might be able to
see in our house, we’ve got a lot of the ocean and that kind of an inspiration. Kayli: Yes, I love it. Rajka: So, I would really like to take these
three pieces here, which I think, I like, but I don’t think they’re right. I would like to incorporate some more of like
the colors that we have and just kind of tie in maybe, as Doug says, these are little bit
to beige maybe. Again, with the wall, so kind of just going
to let you do whatever you think Kayli. Kayli: I love that. Do you want the same sizes? Rajka: I think so, but what do you think? I think that’s kind of the right size for
there. Kayli: I think it’s great, totally. Rajka: And I definitely like the, you know,
having three. Kayli: Got you. Rajka: I kind of like the idea of it maybe
going from a little lighter to darker. Kayli: Yeah, I love that. Rajka: But, I’ll just, again, let you kind
of do your thing. Kayli: I totally love that. I remember you also saying potentially it
being like a sunset going down into the water too. Rajka: That would be awesome. Kayli: Okay. Rajka: That would be really, really awesome. Kayli: Yeah, I think that would be really
cool. Rajka: Yeah, okay. Kayli: I would love that. Rajka: Great. So we are just going to -- well, we’re going
to get some pictures of you working in your space, so that people can kind of see how
that looks and what you do and your process. Kayli: It is pretty cool. Rajka: I mean surfboard resin, who would even
think of any of that? So, we’re just going to show people a little
bit of that and then have you come back and we’ll put the art up and see how it looks. Art Showcase Kayli: I love that. Rajka: Yay! Kayli: Let’s do it. [Music] Rajka: Here we are back with Kayli. Thank you so much. Kayli: Of course. Rajka: She just mounted the pieces and we
absolutely love them. They’re so beautiful. I think they go so well in the house. And, I love it. So, we even added this beautiful piece here
that we put our incense burner on because it was getting ash all over the place. But look at how this ties in with my Mother-in-law’s
painting and has just the whole eye moves across here. Kayli I just love, love this. Kayli: I’m so glad you guys love it. Rajka: Such a cool, cool upgrade to our house. And I will love looking at this everyday thinking
of you and you’re so wrapped up in here. How did it feel? What was your inspiration? Kayli: The water obviously. All the colors that you guys have in your
home, um, they’re such beautiful colors, so it was so easy to work with. It felt really good to make the piece. This is the first piece that I’ve made since
I’ve moved and throughout the whole transition, so it actually felt really, really nice to
make this piece for you guys. Rajka: Oh, I love it. So, this is going to represent sort of new
beginnings. Kayli: Yes, totally. Rajka: New beginnings. Kayli: New beginnings. Rajka: That’s a great thing for us. Kayli: There’s the name. Rajka: The New Beginnings. Kayli: The New Beginnings. Rajka: We just named the pieces. The New Beginnings. I just absolutely adore it. I love how that wood is kind of natural peaking
through there. It’s fantastic. [Music] Rajka: Kayli, how can people find you if they
wanted to sort of commission some art for Outro themselves? I will put links to -- I know you have an
Instagram feed and you can send out stuff. Kayli: Yes. So, that is the only way that people can contact
me right now. Either Instagram, or even just my telephone
number. Rajka: Okay. I’ll put that if you don’t mind. Kayli: I don’t mind at all. Rajka: I’ll put that in the description
below. She’s so talented, so wonderful. I notice you’re getting pieces all over
town, it’s so cool. Kayli: I am. It’s so nice. Rajka: Both in places that are selling them
and places that are just hanging them in their places. So, it’s just so lovely. Kayli: It’s amazing. Rajka: I’m so happy to have found you. I have signed pieces, I know that they’re
going to be worth a ton. It’s doesn’t even matter, they’re worth
a ton to me because they’re just gorgeous and they’ll be with us wherever we go. So, thank you so much, I really appreciate
it. Kayli: Thank you. Rajka: I appreciate you doing the video. And, again, I would encourage people if you
want, find local artists and have a piece of them in your home. You can design what you want to have and it’s
a lot of fun. So, thank you everybody for watching, we really
appreciate. Until next time, have fun and dress it up
a little. [Music]

খেলা করাটা তোমার কাজ না ওহ আরেকটা কথা তুমি তো পাঁচবারের ফেল করা সেই চেয়ারম্যান প্রার্থী না আর আমি হচ্ছি জনগণের ভোটে নির্বাচিত বর্তমান চেয়ারম্যান কাজেই এই দুই চেয়ারম্যান কথা বলাটা কিন্তু ঠিক না ভাই title: Самодельный мопед из бензопилы Урал
description:
Самодельный мопед из бензопилы Урал. Именно о нем пойдет речь в этом выпуске. Для того чтобы сделать его своими руками Вам понадобится: 
-бензопила "Урал" (также подойдет "Дружба" или любой другой двигатель на Ваше усмотрение)
-старый велосипед, который не жалко распилить
-мотоциклетные звезды (в моем случае передаточное число равно 3-м, ведущая - 14   зубьев, ведомая - 41, тип цепи - 420)
-соответствующая цепь (у меня 420)
-ручка газа
-тросик газа
-тормоза (желательно поставить дисковую гидравлику от какого-нибудь мопеда, но я нашел только клещевые от детского велосипеда)

Найдя все эти компоненты, Вы уже сможете ездить, но желательно также раздобыть:
-нормальный карбюратор, для того чтобы бензопила нормально заводилась (я использовал от Альфы 110 кубов)
-бак для того, чтобы бензин не заканчивался в самый неподходящий момент 

ИЗГОТОВЛЕНИЕ
0:21 - разборка велосипеда
0:40 - переделка рамы
0:50 - стапель 
1:11 - переделка звезд под мотоциклетную цепь
1:33 - продолжение изменения рамы
1:48 - крепления бензопилы
2:00 - обзор технической части
2:25 - покраска

ФИНАЛЬНАЯ СБОРКА
2:33 - колеса и вилка
2:40 - установка двигателя
2:47 - установка и натяжка цепи
2:53 - руль и седло
2:55 - ручка газа
2:57 - крепление бензобака
3:01 - подставка для ног
3:04 - тормоза
3:05 - фиксация воздушного фильтра (лучше так не делать)
3:09 - общий вид

ТЕСТ - 3:22

title: Belle Meade Bourbon Summer Cocktail Tutorial: Belle Meade Highball
description:
Lee Glaister – E3 Chophouse

Belle Meade Highball
1.5 oz Belle Meade bourbon
.5 oz Batavia Arrack 
.75 oz lemon juice 
.75 oz peach ginger simple syrup
1 dash rhubarb bitters. 
 
Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake until chilled. Strain into a highball glass, top with soda water and garnish with mint.

My bass is strung with 50/105 flatwounds (from 2003!) and tuned down to C#F#BE

transcript: 선생님 도대체 우리 민서 뭐 먹이신 거예요? 하루 종일 노즈 픽션인가 몸 달라고 울고 불고 난리에요. 아 민서 어머니 요즘 독감 유행 중이라 면역력 높이는 페르세팅 바로 애들한테 매일 먹이고 있어요. 독감 유행으로 결석이 많아져 걱정하던 중에 약사 세 언니의 추천으로 노즈 픽션이라는 걸 알게 됐다. 양파에서 추출한 페르세틴으로 만든 가루인데 애들 면역력 높이는 데에 최고하더라. 바로 우리 딸한테 먹여봤는데 신기하게도 매년 걸리던 감기가 한 번도 안 걸리는 것이었다. 맛도 파인애플 맛이라 더 달라고 때 쓰고 날리다. 효과가 좋아. 바로 우리 반 애들한테도 먹여봤다. 한 2주 정도 지났는데 다른 반 애들 다 걸리는 독감. 우리 바은 단 한 명도 안 걸려 결석이 없다. 심지어 평소 콧물 달고 살던 애들도 아예 없어져서 어머니들이 너무 좋아하신다.

title: 민수기 22장: 보이는 것을 넘어... 보이지 않는 거룩한 열정으로
description: 민수기서 22장에서 25장에서 나오는 발락과, 발람, 비느하스와 짐리의 스토리를 통하여 하나님께서 우리에게 요구하시는 것이 무엇이고, 우리는 무엇을 통하여 진정한 축복과 승리를 경험할 수 있는 지 말씀을 통해 교훈받습니다.
transcript: 오늘의 말씀은 민수기 서의 12장 1절에서 6절 말씀입니다 제목은 보이는 것을 넘어 보이지 않는 거룩한 열정으로 면 속에서 22장 에서 25장 은 하나의 연결된 스토리입니다 당 대한 이야기를 담고 있지만 우린 한 맥락을 찾아서 같이 좀 받기 원합니다 먼저 등장인물들의 구성을 살펴보기 원합니다 달라 미라는 모압 에 왕이 나오고 있습니다 이스라엘이 그 험한 광야 에게 불 뱀이 도사리는 길을 지나 드디어 가나안 땅 여리고를 반대편에 두고 뭐 아베 땅에서 야영 하고 있습니다 이 때 이것을 본 모 아베 왕 발락의 신경을 성경은 무엇이라고 표현하고 있습니까 심히 두려웠다 고 얘기하고 있습니다 뭘보고 두려웠다 고 합니까 이스라엘의 번성한 그들의 숫자를 보고 심히 두려웠다 했습니다 그것이 그의 고민이 되고 번민 이랬다고 합니다 오늘의 스토리는 바로 이 발락이 이스라엘을 보고 생기니 두려움으로 부터 시작되고 있음을 알아야 합니다 강한 아무리 적 속에 시온 와 다산의 왕도 이들에게 참패를 당했고 그들의 성들이 뺏긴 것을 자신의 눈으로 보았다는 것입니다 모험의 왕은 그들과 같은 맹이 되길 두려워 했던 것입니다 이스라엘 민족이 자신들 덮치면 버티기 힘들다는 것을 느꼈습니다 그럼 어떻게 하느냐 이미 강하다는 두 나라의 왕들이 그들 칠려고 나갔지만 이기지 못했어요 힘으로는 안 된다는 것을 알아채 입니다 그래서 그가 알아낸 망 노비 뭡니까 바로 미리안 족속들 과 동맹을 맺고 달라 미라는 사람을 찾기 로 하는 겁니다 오늘 그래서 두번째 나오는 인물이 발람 입니다 발람은 유명한 주술사 였고 얘기 나는 자 있고 그가 말을 하면 이루어지는 신통한 자였습니다 뭐 대 왕 발락이 생각하게 이 싸움에서 이르면 육적인 힘으로 제압하는 것은 불가능하다 보이지 않는 영적인 힘을 우리 편으로 끌어들여야 않나 이렇게 생각했다는 겁니다 이거 보면 발라본 패배한 시험 랑 바 상황 보다 훨씬 똑똑한 거예요 이스라엘 뒤의 역사 고 있는 신의 힘을 인정하고 인지하고 있는 겁니다 그래서 미리안과 사람의 심성을 잘 알고 있는 자에게만 나올 수 있는 응용 하고도 효과적인 묘약 입니다 이스라엘의 하나님은 질투하는 않은 님 두 신을 섬기는 것을 허용하지 않는다 니 그의 백스윙에서 거룩함을 요구하시는 하나님 이라는 것을 알고 이런 요술을 단락의 던져주는 거예요 대 성과를 가져올 뻔 했습니다 모두 이길 뻔 했어요 비누와 스 라는 인물이 없었더라면 이스라엘 당장 2만 4000명이 아니라 몇 십만 명이 죽을 수 있었던 요 책이 어떤 것입니다 하나님의 거룩하신 성품을 이용해 백성과 하나님을 이간질 시킨 겁니다 물론 이것으로 인해 결국 반란과 발락 모두 죽게 되죠 오늘 세번째 물으니 비누 아스란 은 인물입니다 아론의 손자 로써 재 사장직을 담당했던 사람입니다 이 15장을 보면 은 하나님께서 명하신 고 계십니다 title: Barbecue and Blueprints   Troy Heiner   MFT S01E23
description:
"Barbecue and Blueprints"

Join Rathgar for an enlightening and entertaining chat with Troy Heiner in *Mostly Fictional Tales* Season 1, Episode 23, titled "Barbecue and Blueprints." Troy, a retired NSA analyst and cancer survivor, takes us on a journey through his fascinating career—from his early days as a college student designing devices for national security to his time working at the CIA.

Troy shares stories from his time at the NSA, where he focused on signals intelligence (SIGINT) and worked to protect the communications of the nation’s most important assets. He gives us a glimpse into the world of intelligence, drawing comparisons to the iconic Q from James Bond, as he recounts his role in designing gadgets and systems used by field agents.

But it's not all serious business—Troy also brings in his love for music, talking about his bluesy, jazzy band "H.J. and the Short Ribs," and how North Carolina barbecue inspired some of their best moments. Rathgar and Troy mix humor with deep insights, covering everything from the old days of 28.8k modems to the intricacies of signals intelligence. Don’t miss this episode filled with laughter, learning, and a few secrets you never saw coming!

Reporter : 

JAKARTA - Mantan Staf Khusus Presiden ke-7 Joko Widodo, Arif Budimanta, yang saat ini merupakan Ketua Majelis Ekonomi, Bisnis, dan Pariwisata PP Muhammadiyah, meninggal dunia pada Sabtu (6/9/2025), 

pukul 00.06 WIB. Ketua PP Muhammadiyah Bidang Ekonomi dan Bisnis Muhadjir Effendy membenarkan kabar meninggalnya Arif Budimanta. 

"Betul, saya sedang di rumah duka," kata Muhadjir, Sabtu. Rumah duka almarhum Arif Budimanta berada di Rawamangun, Jakarta Timur.

Arif Budimanta turut dikenal sebagai seorang ekonom yang aktif mempublikasikan pemikirannya terhadap isu-isu pembangunan, UMKM, dan ekonomi moneter baik di media massa maupun di forum-forum internasional.

title: 「チェコで学んだのはビールと勝つこと」パリ五輪金メダル北口榛花が“第二の故郷”での祝福セレモニーで“味のある”スピーチ…専属コーチは「足りないのは世界記録」と厳命
youtuber: @エンタメバトルフィールド-y8i
transcript: 北口が槍投げの男女の世界記録保持者を 生み出した強国チェコで言20の ナショナルコーチを務めていた ケセラクリニック 復興と貢献を称え世界陸上で優勝した北口 西の記念メダルを授与されている年間最大 7人に授与できるそうだがこの10年で7 人しか授与されていない名をあるメダルで 北口は史上最年少だったそうだそして ケセラクリニック した時は少なくともこの2倍の人たちが ここに来なければならないでしょうソケ セラックコーチは北口とドマ樹立の人々に 呼びかけた現在の世界記録はチェコの バルボラーチョ ゴリンを連覇したチェコのやり投げの レジェンドで2022年に引退している 北口のジコベストは2023年9月に記録 した67m38パリゴリンでは決勝の1投 目に65m80を投げ2に2m近い差を つけて金メダルを獲得したが試合後には こんな話をしていた夢の中では70mを 投げられていましたオリンピックの金 メダルを取ったら満足できるものなのかな と思っていましたが65mではまだ満足 できません目に65mを投げられたら最後 に70mを投げられると自分の中の イメージがあっただけに70mではなく とも自己ベストくらいは投げられたと思っ ています北口も金メダルをゴールだとは 考えていなかったもう次の瞬間にパリ ゴリンの先にある目標に向けて モチベーションを切り替えていたのである もちろんケセラックコチに減滅された世界 記録更新は大目標だ北口は自らの Instagramにこんなメッセージを 綴っているこれからも私は私の投げ方で夢 を追いかけますそして世界中のライバル たちがいるからこそ苦しくてもさらに上を 目指して頑張れていると思います歴史にが 残っている選手も今一緒に投げている選手 もこれから槍を投げる予定の選手もあなた たちと競うこの瞬間繋がる瞬間が私は 大好きですそのライバルとの列な戦いは ダイヤモンドリーグから始まる

title: Accionan en Guantánamo para evitar alza de precios
description: En Guantánamo, se adoptan medidas para evitar el incremento de los precios ante las medidas anunciadas por el Estado Cubano para beneficiar los ingresos salariales de los trabajadores del sector presupuestado y los pensionados.
transcript: con júbilo se recibió por estos días el anuncio del incremento salarial al sector presupuestado y los pensionados ante el mismo también una advertencia del presidente cubano de velar y adoptar las medidas pertinentes para evitar los incrementos en los precios en el caso nuestro están creando los grupos tanto aquí en la provincia como en el municipio que presiden los vicepresidentes que atienden la economía el instructivo específica que en cada uno de los municipios se deben de realizar estudios a lo que estaba aconteciendo en los precios sobre todo en el sector no estatal antes del primero de julio y con posterioridad a ello y coordinado con este mismo sector y este grupo llevar los consejo administración y aprobar precios topado al trabajo por cuenta propia a las formas a otra forma de gestión a las cooperativas agropecuarias y a la cna agropecuaria en el caso del sector estatal no se pueden mover los precios a simple vista y ha oído de buen cubano pareciera que todos acabaron la advertencia pero a todas luces el dilema oferta precio continúa en la palestra pública por el estado hasta ahora en los lugares que yo he visto el precio sería normal pero los particulares estancaron la cal de principalmente la carne de puerco al precio caro 25 o 30 pesos y en el estado en la carnicería y de paseo de lo único que traen es cabeza y webs la carne y no se le pone en precio el pueblo porque alteran a veces lo parece no pueden alterar la presión a medida que venden el frijol hoy un precio mañana lo venden a otros le dicen una cosa al pueblo y mañana otra en su profesión como ciudadano cubano en un recorrido de nuestro equipo afloran violaciones con justificaciones y pretextos que parecen no temer a las multas precios no visibles para inspectores pero muy bien conocidos para los ciudadanos que necesariamente acuden a esta forma de comercialización como única vía para adquirir muchos productos agropecuarios escasos necesarios y de alta demanda donde más que a nosotros hemos recibido ha sido en los temas de los puntos de venta de la agricultura urbana hoy la población se está centrando principalmente en los precios de la carne decente y hacia eso hemos encaminado un grupo de supervisiones por lo cuales no tenía un resultado ahora en la semana pasada en el tema de la carne de cerdo se aplicaron alrededor de 11 decretos y en él en los otros productos agrícolas 22 decretos eso quiere decir que todavía el grupo de elementos que no tienen o no están conscientes de que deben aplicar los precios para que la población se sienta satisfecha en el servicio que hay un proyecto sin embargo en este mercado la punta donde prevalece oficialmente los precios por oferta y demanda parece no ser este asunto de la visibilidad del costo una problemática y si otra que parece no tener coto siguiendo el llamado de la dirección del país las instrucciones del ministerio de finanzas y precios se adoptan un conjunto de acciones en los territorios el fenómeno es complejo y multicausal pero lo cierto es que urge velar por que los precios no se incrementen en detrimento de la economía familiar es este un hecho que demanda de mayor exigencia y fiscalización estatal pero también del control y la denuncia popular johana cervera a tiempo

Si el 49,5% de los estudiantes ha probado los cigarrillos electrónicos alguna vez en la vida frente al 44% de media en Europa y el 27,1% los ha consumido en los últimos 30 días frente al 22% europeo. title: John tried, but the past won’t let go 🟣 Part 17 🟣 RDR 2
description:
Part 17🟣
They call me loyal, but loyalty’s a hard thing when the world around you starts to rot. I’ve lived by Dutch’s words, ridden through fire and snow for this gang, and bled for a dream that’s slipping through our fingers. I ain’t no hero, never claimed to be either, but I reckon a man can still try to do some good before it’s too late. The land’s beautiful, cruel, and fading, much like the people in it. And somewhere between the gun smoke and guilt, I’ll figure out who Arthur Morgan really is.
Now grab a coffee and settle in.. this story don’t rush for anyone.

title: 【緊急分析】TikTok時代になぜ？二見颯一「夜空」1時間ループが日韓でバズる本当の理由。涙が止まらない「音の処方箋」
description: 【緊急分析】TikTok時代になぜ？二見颯一「夜空」1時間ループが日韓でバズる本当の理由。涙が止まらない「音の処方箋」
transcript: たった15秒で世界の全てが決まって しまうようなこの忙しない現代社会におい てあなたは今心の底から安らぎを感じてい ますか?もしあなたの心が日々の幻想に 疲れ生場のない孤独を感じているのなら 今日のお話はあなたのためのものです。今 日韓の国境を超え数百万人の魂を静かに しかし確実に救済している音のシェルター が存在することをご存知でしょうか? こんにちは。日韓の音楽シーンに隠された 真実と感動をどこよりも深く、そして愛を 持ってお届けするトロットチャンネルへ ようこそ。この物語を聞き終えた時、 あなたの音楽に対する価値観はきっと 大きく変わっているはずです。この静か なる革命の証認となるために是非今のうち にチャンネル登録と高評価、そしてこの 動画のシェアをお願いいたします。あなた のそのワンクリックが良質な音楽を世界に 広める力となります。さて、今日私たちが 向き合うのは私が長年この音楽業界を 見つめてきた中でもこれほどまでに静かで それでいてこれほどまでに力強い現象には 遭遇したことがないと言っても過言では ない。ある驚くべき出来事についてです。 私たちは今音楽の消費スタイルが激変する 時代のまった中にいます。スマートフォン を開けばTikTokやYouTube所 が溢れわずか15秒の間で脳を刺激する 派手なダンス、中毒性のあるBと強烈な フックを持つ楽曲たちが次から次へと流れ てきます。早ければ早いほどいい。刺激的 であればあるほどいい。そんな加速する 時代においてまるで時計の針を止めるかの ような奇跡のような現象が起きているの です。その主役は日本の演下会が誇る若き 司法二見蒼一さん。そして彼が歌う名曲空 です。驚くべきことに今YouTubeを 初めとする動画プラットフォームで爆発的 99999999,"start_time":559.8,"text":"急激にではなくじわじわとしかし確実に"},{"duration":7.6,"end_time":571.0400000000001,"start_time":563.44,"text":"増加し続けました。これは彼の歌声に1度"},{"duration":7.159,"end_time":574.519,"start_time":567.36,"text":"触れた人々がその癒しの効果を忘れられず"},{"duration":7.32,"end_time":578.36,"start_time":571.04,"text":"もう1度あの感覚を味わいたいと能動的に"},{"duration":8,"end_time":582.519,"start_time":574.519,"text":"検索した証拠です。爆発的な拡散ではなく"},{"duration":6.88,"end_time":585.24,"start_time":578.36,"text":"、質の高い再開への欲求。この強力な"},{"duration":6.241,"end_time":588.76,"start_time":582.519,"text":"ロイヤリティを持ったファンたちが1時間"},{"duration":7.64,"end_time":592.88,"start_time":585.24,"text":"ループ動画の再生回数を底上げし、拡散の"},{"duration":8.88,"end_time":597.64,"start_time":588.76,"text":"強固な基盤を作ったのです。第3の要素、"},{"duration":8.68,"end_time":601.56,"start_time":592.88,"text":"それは季節性と年末の心理です。この現象"},{"duration":7.84,"end_time":605.48,"start_time":597.64,"text":"が加速したのはまさに年末の時期でした。"},{"duration":8.16,"end_time":609.7199999999999,"start_time":601.56,"text":"年末というのは誰もが1年を振り返り少し"},{"duration":7.479,"end_time":612.9590000000001,"start_time":605.48,"text":"干渉的になり一肌濃しくなる季節です。冬"},{"duration":7.239,"end_time":616.9590000000001,"start_time":609.72,"text":"の冷たい空気の中で温かい部屋で過ごす"},{"duration":7.32,"end_time":620.279,"start_time":612.959,"text":"安らぎ。夜空が持つ日本的なノスタルジー"},{"duration":6.481,"end_time":623.4399999999999,"start_time":616.959,"text":"古よき昭和の風景を早起させるメロディは"},{"duration":7.12,"end_time":627.399,"start_time":620.279,"text":"この時期の人々の心情に痛いほど刺さり"},{"duration":6.44,"end_time":629.8800000000001,"start_time":623.44,"text":"ます。それは単なる歌ではなく孤独な夜に"},{"duration":6.281,"end_time":633.68,"start_time":627.399,"text":"寄り添ってくれる親友のような存在として"},{"duration":7.32,"end_time":637.2,"start_time":629.88,"text":"機能しました。心の奥底に隠した寂しさや"},{"duration":7.64,"end_time":641.3199999999999,"start_time":633.68,"text":"憂鬱を無理に励ますのではなく、ただ静か"},{"duration":7,"end_time":644.2,"start_time":637.2,"text":"に肯定してくれる。まるで冷たい冬風の後"},{"duration":6.4,"end_time":647.72,"start_time":641.32,"text":"に飲むホットミルクのような優しさが多く"},{"duration":7.92,"end_time":652.12,"start_time":644.2,"text":"の人の心を掴んで話さなかったのです。"},{"duration":7.64,"end_time":655.36,"start_time":647.72,"text":"実際動画のコメント欄はまるで心の診療所"},{"duration":6.399,"end_time":658.519,"start_time":652.12,"text":"のようになっています。いくつかご紹介し"},{"duration":6.56,"end_time":661.92,"start_time":655.36,"text":"ましょう。1時間聞いても全く飽きない"},{"duration":7.281,"end_time":665.8,"start_time":658.519,"text":"どころか心が現れるようです。"},{"duration":7.08,"end_time":669,"start_time":661.92,"text":"二さんの声は私にとって最強の精神安定剤"},{"duration":6.2,"end_time":672,"start_time":665.8,"text":"です。仕事中の集中力が格段に上がりまし"},{"duration":6.639,"end_time":675.639,"start_time":669,"text":"た。もうこれなしでは作業できません。"},{"duration":7.48,"end_time":679.48,"start_time":672,"text":"さらに鋭い洞殺力を持った方はこう表現し"},{"duration":6.961,"end_time":682.6,"start_time":675.639,"text":"ています。二み層一という歌手はすめの"},{"duration":7.159,"end_time":686.639,"start_time":679.48,"text":"ように噛めば噛むほど味が出る。聞けば"},{"duration":7.28,"end_time":689.88,"start_time":682.6,"text":"聞くほど深みが増す。な存在だ。そして"},{"duration":6.241,"end_time":692.88,"start_time":686.639,"text":"興味深いことに最初は試しに1分だけ"},{"duration":5.48,"end_time":695.36,"start_time":689.88,"text":"聞こうと思ったのに気づいたら1時間聞き"},{"duration":7.519,"end_time":700.399,"start_time":692.88,"text":"終わっていたという告白が後を立ちません"},{"duration":8.24,"end_time":703.6,"start_time":695.36,"text":"。これこそが本物の歌声が持つ引力です。"},{"duration":6.721,"end_time":707.12,"start_time":700.399,"text":"無理じーすることなく引き手を心地よい"},{"duration":6.679,"end_time":710.279,"start_time":703.6,"text":"時間泥棒にしてしまうほどの魅力。さらに"},{"duration":6.76,"end_time":713.88,"start_time":707.12,"text":"特質すべきは韓国語のコメントの多さです"},{"duration":7.281,"end_time":717.56,"start_time":710.279,"text":"。ハングルで綴られた感謝と小賛の言葉"},{"duration":6.16,"end_time":720.04,"start_time":713.88,"text":"たちは二さんの歌声が言葉の壁を超え、"},{"duration":6.36,"end_time":723.92,"start_time":717.56,"text":"韓国のリスナーの金銭にも触れていること"},{"duration":6.359,"end_time":726.399,"start_time":720.04,"text":"を証明しています。韓国にはトロットと"},{"duration":6.12,"end_time":730.04,"start_time":723.92,"text":"いう兄弟のようなジャンルがありますが、"},{"duration":6.44,"end_time":732.839,"start_time":726.399,"text":"二さんの持つ日本特有の相性や静寂のは"},{"duration":5,"end_time":735.04,"start_time":730.04,"text":"韓国のファンにとっても新鮮であり、同時"},{"duration":5.481,"end_time":738.32,"start_time":732.839,"text":"にどこか懐かしいものとして受け入れられ"},{"duration":6.96,"end_time":742,"start_time":735.04,"text":"ているようです。専門家や長年の演価"},{"duration":6.6,"end_time":744.9200000000001,"start_time":738.32,"text":"ファンは彼を次世代を担う政党派として"},{"duration":6.16,"end_time":748.16,"start_time":742,"text":"高く評価していますが、私が個人的に"},{"duration":6.599,"end_time":751.519,"start_time":744.92,"text":"最も明を受けているのは彼のぶれない姿勢"},{"duration":6.28,"end_time":754.4399999999999,"start_time":748.16,"text":"です。一家性の流行に乗ってスタイルを"},{"duration":6.201,"end_time":757.72,"start_time":751.519,"text":"変えることなく、自分自身の持ち味である"},{"duration":7.48,"end_time":761.9200000000001,"start_time":754.44,"text":"成熟した落ち着きと丁寧な過小を貫いて"},{"duration":8.119,"end_time":765.839,"start_time":757.72,"text":"いる点です。この誠実さが日本の30代"},{"duration":7.64,"end_time":769.56,"start_time":761.92,"text":"以上の層、つまり生活基盤が安定し、本物"},{"duration":7.12,"end_time":772.9590000000001,"start_time":765.839,"text":"の質を求める層の心を深く掴んでいます。"},{"duration":8.16,"end_time":777.7199999999999,"start_time":769.56,"text":"彼らは1度ファンになればその中心は非常"},{"duration":7.44,"end_time":780.399,"start_time":772.959,"text":"に高いのです。この1時間動画の成功は"},{"duration":6.359,"end_time":784.0790000000001,"start_time":777.72,"text":"単に再生数が伸びたという数字以上の意味"},{"duration":7.281,"end_time":787.68,"start_time":780.399,"text":"を持っています。まず演価コミュニティに"},{"duration":7.681,"end_time":791.76,"start_time":784.079,"text":"おいて二層総一というブランドを信頼"},{"duration":7.92,"end_time":795.5999999999999,"start_time":787.68,"text":"できる癒しの象徴として確立させました。"},{"duration":7.439,"end_time":799.199,"start_time":791.76,"text":"そして何より普段演化を聞かない弱年想や"},{"duration":5.84,"end_time":801.44,"start_time":795.6,"text":"勉強仕事のために音楽を聞く層を彼の新た"},{"duration":6.32,"end_time":805.519,"start_time":799.199,"text":"なリスナーとして取り込むことに成功し"},{"duration":7.72,"end_tim description:
A Frosthaven series following the Circle of Yggdrasil through the Core Campaign with possible Solo Scenarios as they appear. This episode is on +1 difficulty as per the Solo Rules suggest. I try to explain my decision making along the way without diving too deep into how the game is played, though I do explain some details as they come up in and out of scenarios. 

Buy Me A Coffee https://www.buymeacoffee.com/JaugerPlays
DISCORD https://discord.gg/3XdYN7rfFz
TWITTER https://www.twitter.com/JaugerPlays
----
CREDITS:
Sound Effects from Pixabay.com
----
Frosthaven is the story of a small outpost far to the north of the capital city of White Oak, an outpost barely surviving the harsh weather as well as invasions from forces both known and unknown. There, a group of mercenaries at the end of their rope will help bring back this settlement from the edge of destruction. Not only will they have to deal with the harsh elements, but there are other, far more dangerous threats out in the unforgiving cold as well. There are Algox, the bigger, more yeti-like cousins of the Inox, attacking from the mountains; Lurkers flooding in from the northern sea; and rumors of machines that wander the frozen wastes of their own free will. The party of mercenaries must face all of these perils, and perhaps in doing so, make peace with these new races so they can work together against even more sinister forces.

In this video, we're going to explore the concept of hypothesis testing, a fundamental idea in statistics and econometrics. Hypothesis testing is a crucial tool for economists, researchers, and analysts to make informed decisions based on data analysis. We'll delve into the world of confidence intervals, type 2 errors, and null hypotheses, explaining how they relate to hypothesis testing statistics. You'll learn how to interpret p-values and understand the different types of errors that can occur in statistical tests. This video is perfect for beginners in econometrics, Ugc net economics, and anyone looking to gain a solid understanding of hypothesis testing. By the end of this video, you'll be able to apply hypothesis testing to real-world problems and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

Intercooler throttle body EGR kita copot cuci bersihkan. [Musik] Saluran pembakaran injection pump fuel rail common rail injector internal injector. Kita bersihkan jet cleaning dengan cairan khusus diesel jet cleaner. [Musik] Akhir kata saya mengucapkan terima kasih untuk Bapak yang telah mempercayakan mobilnya untuk dilakukan tun up penggantian oli mesin dan oli transmisi di bengkel FT Garaj. title: BFI Film Academy Showcase 2020
description:
Find out about the BFI Film Academy course from recent graduates and young filmmakers from across the UK.

Subscribe: http://bit.ly/subscribetotheBFI

Watch more on BFI Player: http://player.bfi.org.uk/

transcript: quiet on set really action the bf5 film academy is life-changing eye-opening unique inspiring encouraging inclusive diverse helpful motivational and loads of fun the bff film academy is for talented 16 to 19 year olds we deliver 50 courses across the uk they gain specialist skills in our courses so they can work towards a career in the film industry they want to learn about the different roles in the industry and they want to learn about the next steps they want to learn about getting their foot in the door this provides them with a really good opportunity we offer specialist courses in documentary animation script writing and craft skills are you feeling anyway at live we've talked to editors directors it gives you much more of a rounded appreciation of what goes on in the film so we work with cameras and boom mics learning from people who are at the top of their game it's given me hands-on experience and contacts as well at the time i didn't have any film experience and they still gave me that first chance we've had master classes with professionals and they talked to us about how they began it's great to finally have a sense of community people from all sorts of places come together and relate to each other the young people that graduates have access to a number of opportunities which includes mentoring programs and a traineeship program we place young people in the industry we work with lucasfilm we work with disney and we've worked with eon on bond the bfi film academy gives lucasfilm such a passionate group of people it enhances creativity and innovation on our sets it got me the role of script trainee on the rise of skywalker i would never have been on black widow if it hadn't been for the academy the alumni care is so strong it's definitely helped me to create my own production company for marginalised groups if you want to do film it's something you should definitely look to do it opens a lot of doors i'm loving this experience we want to make sure that voices are heard from across the uk and we want to make sure that the bfi film academy supplies the next generation of young filmmakers to the film industry 2、Obstacle avoidance.

3、Cut up the fruit.


There are hundreds of levels, so come and challenge yourself!

title: Steo Wall  'Ancient Wisdom'   Pantisocracy S4 E6
description:
In this episode of the ‘cabaret of conversations’ host Panti Bliss is joined by artists who have found freedom in their art and work and those who have a sense of understanding Maya Angelou’s meaning ‘I Know why the caged bird sings’. Meet visual artist Mary Duffy who is a thalidomide survivor and paints, and gardens, with her feet. Her work is beautiful, evocative and life-affirming, capturing the colours and the coastal landscape of where she lives. With her in studio is Steo Wall a man who has known the confines of a cage and has found his voice through music and song. They are joined by Afro-Irish singer and musician Caleb Kunle and traveller activist, advocate and academic Dr Sindy Joyce.

http://pantisocracy.ie/s4-e6/ for more

title: Hace años, salí de Uruguay con una bicicleta
description:
Hace años, salí de Uruguay con una bicicleta, una mochila ligera… y un corazón lleno de preguntas.
No sabía exactamente qué buscaba.
transcript: Hace años salí de Uruguay con una bicicleta, una mochila ligera y un corazón lleno de preguntas. No sabía exactamente qué buscaba, solo sentía que tenía que moverme, que tenía que salir a encontrar respuestas más allá de lo [Música] conocido. Durante 6 años recorrí rincones en soledad. El asfalto fue mi compañero más constante. La lluvia, el viento, el calor se volvieron parte de mi vida diaria. Pedaleaba hacia lugares nuevos, pero también hacia dentro de mí mismo. Aprendí a dormir bajo el cielo abierto, a comer con lo que había, a escuchar mis propios pensamientos en medio de la nada. La bicicleta me enseñó a ser paciente, a ser fuerte, a confiar en que cada amanecer traía una nueva oportunidad. Y entonces, cuando menos lo esperaba, el destino me llevó a México, a Chihuahua, para ser exactos. Y fue ahí donde la vida me regaló algo que nunca imaginé encontrar en el camino. Una compañera de ruta, una cómplice de sueños, una nueva aventura que ya no sería en solitario. Desde hace 3 años no solo compartimos los kilómetros, compartimos el peso de las alforjas, los amaneceres helados, los atardeceres que arden en el horizonte. Compartimos la risa al preparar una comida sencilla, el silencio al buscar un rincón donde plantar la tienda de campaña sin ser vistos. En esta segunda etapa en Estados Unidos aprendimos a viajar de forma más sabia, a encontrar lugares donde parecía que no había lugar, a entender que el mapa no muestra todos los caminos. Algunos solo se descubren con el corazón abierto y la mirada atenta. Ahora nuestras alforjas van llenas de frutas, verduras, huevos, pollo y a veces pan, algunos dulces y gaseosas y otras veces algún vino para celebrar. Alimentamos el cuerpo, pero también el espíritu. Viajamos más ligeros de miedos, más pesados de aprendizajes. Hemos vivido días donde el frío duele y días donde el calor nos derrite. Pero cada noche sabemos que valió la pena, que no importa si hoy fue difícil, mientras estemos juntos seguimos rodando hacia adelante porque aprendimos y entendimos que no se trata de llegar a un destino. Se trata de cada día elegido, de cada paso dado, de cada kilómetro compartido, de cada sueño que a fuerza de pedalear dejamos de soñar y empezamos a vivir. Listo.

   Indian Railways (IR) is a #statutory #trains #body under the #jurisdiction of #Ministry of Railways , #Government of #India that operates India's #national #fourth-largest #railway #network in the #world by size, #with a #route #length of #67,956 km (42,226 mi) as of 31 March 2020. 45,881 #km (28,509 mi) or 71% of all the #broad-gauge #routes are #electrified with 25 kV 50 Hz AC #electric #traction

The #maximum #speed of #passenger #trains varies, with the #Gatimaan #Express running at a #peak speed of 160 km/h (99 mph).
In the freight #segment, #IR runs 8,479 #trains daily.[4] The #average #speed of #freight #trains is #around 24 km/h (15 mph). The #maximum speed of freight #trains varies from 60–75 km/h (37–47 mph) #depending on their #axle load with 'container #special' trains #running at a peak #speed of 100 km/h (62 mph).
As of #March 2020, #Indian #Railways' #rolling #stock #consisted of 2,93,077 freight wagons, 76,608 #passenger #coaches and 12,729 #locomotives.IR owns #locomotive and #coach-#production facilities at several #locations in India. It had 1.254 #million #employees as of March 2020, #making it the #world's #eighth-largest #employer.The #government has #committed to #electrifying #India's entire rail network by 2023–24, and become a "net-zero (carbon emissions) #railway" by 2030.The #first #railway #proposals for #India were #made in #Madras in 1832.[8] The country's #first #train, #Red #Hill Railway (built by Arthur #Cotton to transport granite for road-building), ran from Red Hills

title: Harold MacIntyre: "Pressures Of Progress", The Larry Coad Benefit, 2012
description:
A fund-raiser for the benefit of Larry Coad, a well-known musician & song writer, who is facing some personal issues at the moment. Easily a couple hundred people showed up at the 'The Oakland Place' in Hamilton, Ont. on a sunny Sunday afternoon. Colin Butler & Steve Piticco organized and hosted this 'country music' tribute, along with performances by Harold MacIntyre, Bllind River, 14 yrear old Lyric Dubee, Deborah Ross, Derek Pilgrim, Terry Roberts, Leslie Grant, Wray Oakes, George Gero and the Larry Coad Allstar Band with Steve Piticco, Colin Butler, Val Leblanc, Kurk Burnard, Joe Allain, Bill Carruthers, Danny Pisquale with Don Ried on fiddle. There are 30 performances captured 'live'...I hope you enjoy the  music as much as I enjoyed videotaping it on my little camera.
Harold MacIntyre was born September 7,1948 on Cape Breton Island in Nova Scotia. Started singing and playing guitar as a boy. In 1967 moved to Toronto, started playing music locally.
First recording in early 70′s; went on to record 5 albums. 1981 Big Country's New Artist of the Year, 1984 Country Music News Male Vocalist (female vocalist was Ann Murray). Nominated for 4 Juno's from 1981 to 1984. Harold has played with all the great acts of country music, from Conway Twitty, Waylon Jennings and George Jones to all our wonderful Canadian artists like Carroll Baker, Johnny Burke and Terry Sumsion. Harold's music ranges from his Celtic ditties to warm soft love songs. Harold continues to perform and is always well received and appreciated by his many fans.

title: Минздрав Израиля предупредил об опасности заражения глазным возбудителем

title: Evans Fox LLP   July Video   What should you expect in a divorce
transcript: Hi, I'm John Bonavilla, partner here at Evans Fox. I'm here to talk to you today about the divorce process and what to expect. There's a lot of fear and misapprehension people have out there about this process. And many people think this a divorce means a trial and fighting tooth and nail with your spouse. Well, this is certainly true in some cases should know that the vast majority of these cases settle before they go to trial and many times without even having to get the court involved. They're certainly not all necessarily contentious. Now certainly some can be particularly if one party is doing something they shouldn't like hiding assets or causing trouble with respect to the children the finances. The court is always available in those circumstances to get involved and provide some relief. But in essence with any divorce all that happens is the parties are going to exchange financial affidavits so they each can see what the assets and the debts are to the marriage. If uh there are any children involved then we make sure they're provided for as well. If either side has any questions about the assets or what's become of them, documents can be requested and questions asked under oath. Then the sides can talk about how to divide things up equitably and try and negotiate a settlement. If that can't happen, formal litigation is always available and a trial if necessary. Now, as you might expect, uh this is never an enjoyable experience for anybody, but it's nothing to be afraid of. The important thing is to make sure you have good legal representation so you know what you're entitled to and you know what your rights are. I hope this allay some of your fears about this process. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us and we'll be happy to help. Thank you. Have a good day.

title: Wes Anderson's world celebrated in Paris exhibition
description:
(18 Mar 2025) 
FRANCE WES ANDERSON 

SOURCE: ASSOCIATED PRESS

RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

LENGTH: 6:43

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Paris, France - 17 March 2025

1. American filmmaker Wes Anderson posing for photographers as he arrives for exhibition opening celebrating his work at La Cinematheque Francaise in Paris  
2. Cutaway of photographers 
3. Wes Anderson posing for photographers with French composer Alexandre Desplat who won an Academy Award for scoring Anderson’s “The Grand Budapest Hotel”
4. Wes Anderson posing for photographers with French writer/director/actor Nicolas Saada who was an actor in Anderson’s “The French Dispatch”
5. Wide interior of Wes Anderson exhibit featuring large portrait of Anderson photographed by Laura Wilson 
6. Various of costumes from “The Royal Tenenbaums” (released 2001) featuring a red Adidas tracksuit worn by Ben Stiller, a long fur coat worn by Gwyneth Paltrow and the suit with polo shirt worn by Luke Wilson
7. Various of painting portraying Commander Zissou played by Bill Murray in “The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou" (released 2005)
8. Various of props and costumes designed by Milena Canonero from "The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou"
9. SOUNDBITE (English) Johanna Agerman Ross, co-curator of the Wes Anderson exhibit/chief curator at the London Design Museum:
“The very special aspect of this exhibition and of Wes Anderson's work is that he has meticulously kept many of the props and objects that you see in this exhibition throughout his over 30 year long career. So starting with 'Rushmore' (released 1998), which is one of the first films that we're looking at in this exhibition, he started to store and retain the props that he had created for the film.”

10. Various of framed photographs of Wes Anderson during the making of his first films “Bottle Rocket” (released 1996) and “Rushmore” (released 1998) featuring American actor Owen Wilson, who co-wrote and starred in “Bottle Rocket” and co-wrote "Rushmore"
11. Various of props and costumes from “Rushmore” including red beret and blazer worn by actor Jason Schwartzman
12. SOUNDBITE (English) Matthieu Orlean, co-curator of the Wes Anderson exhibit/chief curator at la Cinematheque Francaise:
“What has never been shown, I think, is a little bit about his method of working, which means storyboarding his designing. Also notebooks he’s keeping, Polaroids, things that are part of his process. And people know that he's (Wes Anderson) not the kind of film director who will make improvisation when he's on the set. Everything has been thought, has been anticipated. It doesn't mean that there's no variation on the set, but he's a film director that knows a lot about what he wants to have in the frame before even the shooting begins. So all these, like storyboarding, show how much he has the movie in his mind before being with a camera even.”

13. Visitors looking at the framed storyboard pages for “Bottle Rocket” drawn by Wes Anderson 
14. Close of storyboard pages for “Bottle Rocket” drawn by Wes Anderson 
15. Various of model of "The Grand Budapest Hotel" (released 2014) used in the namesake film
16. SOUNDBITE (English) Matthieu Orlean, co-curator of the Wes Anderson exhibit/chief curator at la Cinematheque Francaise:

17. Pan of framed sketches of characters from “The Grand Budapest Hotel”
18. Tilt up of Zero the lobby boy costume designed by Milena Canonero for "The Grand Budapest Hotel”
19. Various of costumes designed by Milena Canonero from “The Darjeeling Limited” (released 2007)
20. Pan of “The Darjeeling Limited” section of exhibition 

27. Various of puppets from “Isle of Dogs”

title: Emerging Senegal: Guaranteed
description:
This is the story of the Dakar Port, and how Senegal got a world-class container terminal thanks to the investments of Dubai Port World. It's also the story of Standard Chartered Bank and MIGA, the risk insurance arm of the World Bank Group, which worked together to finance this big-ticket infrastructure project. Today, the regional economy is benefiting, and any company that imports or exports is learning that "time is money."

www.miga.org

MiGA’s mission is to end extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity by promoting foreign direct investment into developing countries. It is a member of the World Bank Group.

title: Ocean Waves Bag Free Crochet Pattern Workshop ~ Cute Purse, Lunch Tote, Beach Bag Pattern
description:
Free Pattern Link: https://knitandcrocheteverafter.com/free-patterns/free-pattern-workshops/ocean-waves-bag-workshop

Yarn I'm using: http://shrsl.com/3by42
Hook I'm using: https://amzn.to/3pVU4eL

I wanted to make a lunch bag that was good for the environment (forget brown-bagging it, it's all about the "green" bags now) and I wanted it to be summery. This is what I came up with. The colors remind me of the sand and waves of the beach. I gave the bag generous straps so you can easily tie them to close off the top and still have enough strap to hang it off your wrist or stroller.

I can't always reply to all my comments. Please visit my "contact me" page if you have a question or comment you would like me to respond to: https://knitandcrocheteverafter.com/about/contact-me/

title: Pundits Praise Donald Trump's 'Presidential' Performance

I am here tonight to deliver a message of unity and strength, and it is a message deeply delivered from my heart. I thought it was, by far, the best speech I've ever heard Donald Trump give. It was one of the best speeches in that setting I've ever heard any president give Who know that he could be unifying? He finally came out and vociferously, full-throatedly condemned anti-semitic acts. That was a great way to start. A great unifying and so needed way to start. We've seen him break lots of molds as a candidate and as a president, and he broke the mold by sitting right inside the mold because for him that is a different way of approaching it. The tone was smart and a lot of it is the expectations game going into any of these speeches. That thing you just saw him do, if he finds a way to do that over and over again, he's going to be there for eight years.

transcript: ม.ค [เพลง] ถ้า [เพลง] [ปรบมือ] [เพลง] ทำวิธีสาวสวาทตัวหน้าระดับคลำวิญญาณสองคน นี้ทุกเดี๋ยวกับปีศาจเท่าแน่ที่พักถังอิน ก็คือถังทรายตอนที่อยู่เย่เซียนเท่านั้น มองข้ามไปศิรินทร์ ค่ะ นกถังซ้อนก็จะมาทำไมไม่แจ้งให้ข้ารู้โดย ตรงเลยล่ะครับเจ้ามาไม่ดีกว่าเหรอเสี่ยง คือเอาแต่บ่นถึงเจ้าแน่ ผมจะพายอดถวายบังคม [เพลง] พระประสงค์ของพระองค์ท่านสาดน้องครับแต่ ที่มาครั้งนี้พวกโสเชิญมารักษาฝ่าบาทไม่ ทราบว่าจะให้เราเข้าไปรักษาก่อนได้หรือ ไม่เรื่องเสด็จพ่อในลำบากเจ้าแล้วไม่ง่าย นะที่เจ้าจะเข้าวังสู้ให้ข้าต้อนรับเจ้า ดีกว่าเรามาคุยกันดีกว่ามั้งแต่ดูเหมือน พูดที่โซ่อยู่นี่เป็นของสำนักวิญญาณยุ ทั้งหมดองค์รัชทายาท หนังสั้นๆจะพูดได้ไว้อะไรนี่คือที่ต้อง ห้ามของหวังในจักรวรรดิเทียนต่อจะมีคน สำนักวิญญาณหยุดได้จังเลยจะทายาทพระองค์ เผยที่รู้ซะแล้ว 2 คนข้างกายพระองค์คง เป็นราชทินนามประยุทธ์เหตุใดไม่เป็นคุ้ม กันมหาจักพรรดิกลับมาล้อมรอบพระองค์แล้ว เราจะที่ดาวประยุทธ์มีน้อยจะนับนิ้วได้ ถ้าไม่ใช่ที่นั่นจะมีใครได้อีกเหรอข้อ 2 พระองค์นำองครักษ์ทรัพย์เรียนเป็นวิญญา จานเพื่อคุ้มครองฝ่าบาทจริงเหรอ แล้วเหตุใดต้องปิดบังเสนาบดีซึ่งก็คือ อาจารย์ค่าข้อ 3 แค่พระองค์เจอข้ารู้ตัว ตนของข้าจะไปรู้สึกสงสัยป้ายของในมือฆ่า จากนั้นเข้าถึงมั่นใจก็ต้องสิริกับสำนัก วิญญาณหยุดถึงได้รู้จักพวกเขาว่าถังอินก็ คือถังทรายองค์รัชทายาทเข้าว่าค่า วิเคราะห์ไม่ 8-9 ส่วนถูกไหมอ่ะ 4  07 จิตวิญญาณเจ็บตลาดสื่อหลายค่อกับ แค่ที่รถเล็กๆน้อยๆก็ยังคาดเดาได้ขนาดนี้ แต่เจ้าจะพิสูจน์การคาดเดาของตัวเองยังไง ล่ะนั้นง่ายมากให้กระบองเข้าเฝ้าทุกอย่าง ก็จะพิสูจน์ได้แล้วจะว่า มีชุดจะยอมให้เราทำลายแผลของท่านได้ยังไง ถูกต้องเจ้าเราถูกแล้วก็หยิบยืมกำลัง สำนักวิญญาณหยุดจริงๆแต่ในวังมีจราจลนอก วางมีภัย 5 ทำไปก็พระจนใจทั้งศาลอยู่ช่วย ค่าในวังหลวง เน้นท้องสาวงามตำแหน่งหรือวงแหวนยากระดูก วิญญาณเค้าก็ให้ดังต่อการที่เจ้าช่วยข้า สร้างจักรวรรดิเฮียงโตด้วยการเสียชิงเหอ คิดว่าข้าจะติดตามกรรมบทที่ฆ่าพ่อตัวเอง อย่างนั้นเลยอ่ะเต็มถังซานจากฉลาดขนาดนี้ ยังไม่เข้าใจอีกแล้วว่าจะพูดเลือดข้าบท เรื่องแบบนี้ถ้าโยมไม่ปล่อยเจ้าไปแน่ๆ ทำไมต้องทำให้ตัวเองลำบาก

title: Robert Merrill: Verdi - La Traviata, 'Di Provenza il mar'
description:
Robert Merrill (June 4, 1917 -- October 23, 2004) was an American operatic baritone, who was also active in the musical theatre circuit. He received the National Medal of Arts in 1993. Merrill's 1944 operatic debut was in Verdi's Aida at Newark, New Jersey, with the famous tenor Giovanni Martinelli, then in the later stages of his long operatic career. Merrill, who had continued his vocal studies under Samuel Margolis made his debut at the Metropolitan Opera as winner of the Metropolitan Opera Auditions of the Air in 1945, as Germont in La traviata. Also in 1945, Robert Merrill recorded a 78rpm record set with Jeanette MacDonald featuring selections from the operetta Up In Central Park; MacDonald and Merrill did two duets together on this album. In 1951, Merrill did a series of duet recordings together with the Swedish tenor Jussi Björling, including the world-renowned recording of "Au fond du temple saint" from the opera Les pêcheurs de perles by Georges Bizet. Again in 1952 Merrill and Björling, as well as Victoria de los Ángeles made a widely admired recording of Puccini's La bohème, conducted by Sir Thomas Beecham. In 1953, Merrill, Björling, de los Angeles and Zinka Milanov recorded the complete Pagliacci and Cavalleria rusticana... http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Merrill


Lyrics & English Translation

The sea and soil of Provence 
Who has erased them from your heart?
From your native, fulsome sun --
What destiny stole you away?
Oh, remember in your sorrow
That joy glowed on you,
And that only there peace
Can yet shine upon you.
The heavens have given me guidance. 
Ah, your old father 
You don't know how much he has suffered!
With you far away, with misery
Has his house become full?
But if in the end I find you again,
If hope did not fail within me,
If the voice of honour
Didn't become silenced in you,
The Heavens have heard me!

title: شرح مقدمة التفسير 09
description:
اسم الكتاب: مقدمة في أصول التفسير

العلم الذي ينتمي إليه: علم التفسير

 أهميَّة الكتاب: هو من أهم ما كتبه ابن تيمية بيانًا على منهجه في التفسير وأصوله عنده، فقد ضمَّنها القواعد الأساسية التي تفتح طريق فهم القرآن، وتضع بين يدي المفسِّر أصول الموازنة والترجيح بين الأقوال والآراء، وتعصمه من الخطأ والزلل، ويبدو أنه وضع هذه الرسالة بعد أن قطع شوطًا كبيرًا في تفسير القرآن؛ ذلك أن ابن تيمية كان يجلس في صبيحة كل جمعة على الناس يفسر القرآن العظيم. وسبب تأليفها أن بعض طلاب الشيخ رغب أن يُوْقِفَه على طريق التفسير، وأن يبين له سبيل التمييز فيه بين الحق وأنواع الأباطيل، فكأن هذا الطالب فطن إلى أن شيخه له في التفسير قواعدُ كليةٌ وأصولٌ كبرى لا يتجاوزها، فأراد من شيخه بيانَها، وتبيانَ الدليل الفاصل بين الأقاويل

مؤلف الكتاب ومنزلته العلميَّة: تقي الدين أبو العباس أحمد بن عبد الحليم بن عبد السلام النميري الحراني (المتوفى: 728هـ)  المشهور باسم ابن تيميِّة، وهو فقيه ومحدث ومفسر وعالم مسلم مجتهد من علماء أهل السنة والجماعة. وهو أحد أبرز العلماء المسلمين خلال النصف الثاني من القرن السابع والثلث الأول من القرن الثامن الهجري، ونشأ ابن تيميِّة حنبلي المذهب فأخذ الفقه الحنبلي وأصوله عن أبيه وجده، كما كان من الأئمة المجتهدين في المذهب، فقد كان يفتي في العديد من المسائل على خلاف معتمد الحنابلة لما يراه موافقاً للدليل من الكتاب والسُنة ثم على آراء الصحابة وآثار السلف

title: East Isles Online presentation
transcript: Hi, my name is Colleen O’Dell and I’m a senior planner and landscape architect. This presentation is about The Mall Park Woonerf, Trail, and Site Improvements project as well as the East Isles Sewer Improvements project. These are combined projects that we are partnering, Met Council and Minneapolis Park Board together to bring to the community so that we can take advantage of both construction periods happening at the same time. As you see from this map, the Met Council Environmental Services, sanitary sewer work is indicated here in orange between Bde Maka Ska Parkway East and Humboldt Avenue. And the Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board’s Woonerf and Trail Connection work will be on the eastern end of The Mall Park between Hennepin Avenue and Humboldt Avenue, as well as including some restored turf grass in between Irving and Bde Maka Ska Parkway East. I'm going to turn it over to my colleague, Chad Davison. (CHAD) Thank you, Colleen. My name is Chad Davison, and I work for the Metropolitan Council. I am a principal engineer, the project manager for the replacement of our pressure sewer pipe that goes through The Mall Park. That pressure pipe is part of a much larger system that starts out in Hopkins. That forcemain pumps water all the way through Saint Louis Park, Minneapolis, and to a point that's two blocks north of The Mall on Humboldt. This project is the continuation of some work that was done in 2022 and 2023, where we replaced the forcemain that was underneath the street of Humboldt Avenue. This portion of this work is going to be between Bde Maka Ska Parkway and Humboldt. We have a 30-inch concrete pipe that has been corroding from the wastewater gases, and we're going to replace it with two plastic pipes that will be corrosion-resistant and should protect the area from health and environmental concerns of the sanitary sewer for many years to come. I’m going to turn it over to Colleen again. (COLLEEN) Thanks, Chad. The Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board is also taking the opportunity at this time, while construction is happening, to move several site improvements at The Mall Park into the construction design phase. And these are improvements that were already adopted by our Board of Commissioners as part of the Southwest Service Area Master Plan in 2020. And that particular plan for The Mall Park focuses on these three main elements. First is conversion of existing internal park roadway to a shared-use Woonerf and flexible market street, which my colleague Britta is going to speak about in a bit. The installation of multi-use trail connection between Midtown Greenway and Hennepin Avenue, which will be multi-use for both bicycles and pedestrians, and then the replacement of some parts of the internal roadway at the west end of the park with forested green space, primarily with an eye toward stormwater management and improvement of water quality in the Chain of Lakes. Here is that adopted plan, long-range plan, for The Mall Park. And as you see, there are a number of improvements here circled in blue, starting at the east end. Numbers three, two numbers three, which are the shared-use flexible market street between Hennepin Avenue and Humboldt Avenue South, as well as number four, which is the Midtown Greenway multi-use trail connection and updated walkway. At the western end of the existing park, numbers nine, couple of numbers nine, are the forested and open green space that is planned to be implemented. I'm going to hand it over to Britta. (BRITTA) Hi, I'm Britta Hansen, landscape architect with Emmons & Olivier Resources. We are the consultant design team working with Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board to design these site improvements within The Mall Park project. Two main improvements that we are working on right now include the Trail Connection between the Midtown Greenway and Hennepin Avenue and the Woonerf between Humboldt Avenue South and Hennepin Avenue. The Trail Connection will feature a multi-use bicycle and pedestrian trail connecting to the Midtown Greenway at Humboldt Avenue South, which will connect through The Mall Park to Hennepin Avenue South. The Woonerf will be designed and implemented between Humboldt Avenue and Hennepin Avenue within The Mall Park. A Woonerf is a Dutch term for a shared living street. It includes common space shared by pedestrians, bicyclists, and low speed motor vehicles. Woonerf design utilizes traffic-calming techniques such as surmountable curves and bump outs and stormwater plantings to reduce the speed of vehicular traffic. Woonerfs prioritize pedestrian movement. They can still accommodate parking, but that is not their primary function. Their primary function is to facilitate community engagement and safe pedestrian experiences. Concurrent with that design, we’ll also be implementing stormwater management features. These will be done through the design and implementation of green stormwater infrastructure and sustainable landscaping, which will be woven through The Mall Park Woonerf. And this will be used to filter and clean runoff before it enters the Chain of Lakes. (COLLEEN) Thanks, Britta. So how did we arrive at this design that's currently being implemented at The Mall Park? This park plan is a part of the Southwest Service Area Master Plan, which was a large planning and engagement effort that the Park Board undertook around 2018, 2019, and 2020. It included a really broad community engagement, including community advisory committee meetings, open houses, workshops, design weeks, social media videos, surveys, focus groups, and other interviews. So we really heard from a lot of folks about what they'd like to see, not only in The Mall Park, but in all parks serving as a system in the southwest part of Minneapolis. The schedule for this combined project is the two open houses we're going to be having this fall, a number of mailings to neighbors in the area, other outreach activities, an online survey this year, yet to come. We hope to finalize the design of the trail route and the park amenities later this year, early into next year, with design concept approval in early 2024. That means that combined construction would happen summer or fall of next year, 2024, with some final restoration activities in the spring and summer of 2025. We hope that by doing these two projects together, we can minimize disruptions to the neighborhood and bring you these improvements in a timely manner by utilizing efficiencies in construction. Thank you for attending this presentation. We hope that we answered some questions. If you have any additional questions or would like to learn more, you're welcome to reach out to either agency. Met Council Environmental Services at 612-439-5225. You can email us at info@EastIslesSewerProject.com or check out the project web page at metrocouncil.org/SewerConstruction/EastIsles You can also reach out to the Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board. My name is Colleen O'Dell and my number is 612-230-6469. You can email me at codell@minneapolisparks.org or check out our project web page at minneapolisparks.org/MallRenovation Thanks again.

title: 7 minute self-care practice ✨💆‍♀️🥰
What are Rate Classes when it comes to life insurance?
description:
In this weeks episode we talk about how insurance companies will use you height and weight to determine your health and rate class. Rate classes can either lower or increase your premiums. Most insurance companies will have rate classes consisting of:

Standard rate(decent health)
Standard Plus rate(good health)
Preferred rate(great health)
Preferred rate(very great health)

Standard rates give you the standard quote and preferred will give you the cheapest quote and again this will be based off your height and weight. Also if you’re considered overweight based on their height to weight chart, your premium will increase.

title: Satgas Awasi Spekulan Pangan di Bekasi
description: Satgas Pangan dari Kepolisian Resor Metro Bekasi Kota dan Dinas Perdagangan Pemerintah Kota Bekasi melakukan sidak pedagang dan agen bahan pokok untuk mencegah aksi spekulan yang memainkan harga. Komite Pedagang Pasar pun berharap agar menindak tegas para spekulan dengan hukuman yang setimpal.
transcript: the Sagas pangan dari Kepolisian Resort Metro Bekasi Kota dan Dinas Perdagangan Pemerintah Kota Bekasi melakukan sidak pedagang dan agen bahan pokok untuk mencegah aksi spekulan yang memainkan harga komite pedagang pasar pun berharap agar menindak tegas para spekulan dengan hukuman yang setimpal Hai Satgas pangan dari Kepolisian Resort Metro Bekasi Kota dan Dinas Perdagangan Pemerintah Kota Bekasi melakukan sidak ketersediaan pangan guna mengantisipasi tindakan spekulan tidak dilakukan juga untuk memastikan stabilitas harga kebutuhan bahan pangan dari hasil interogasi sejumlah pedagang dan agen harga bahan pangan dijual dengan harga normal para pedagang mengaku tidak melakukan permainan harga kasatreskrim Polres Metro Bekasi Kota AKBP Arman mengatakan pihaknya mendapat laporan dari masyarakat terkait mahalnya harga bahan pokok dan gas elpiji dengan memanfaatkan situasi di tengah kegelisahan masyarakat akibat wabah covert nine ten Nah kamu pastikan ke agen saat ini yo nanti bisa menjelaskan bahwa harga sebenarnya normal dan tidak ada kelangkaan dari agen-agen harga tepat belas ribu 2010 reagen dan tidak ada kelangkaan Nah kenapa bisa jadi Rp25.000 per kilogram per tabung di masyarakat ini akan kita cari tahu kemungkinan Hai ada permainan di pangkalan dan di pengecer nya damai akan menggunakan mendata mereka itu bakal naik dengan ijinnya Apakah mereka begini atau tidak Kalau tidak berizin kita akan susah menindaklanjutinya tato kami akan tindak lanjut secepatnya supaya mereka berizin komite pedagang pasar atau KPP berharap pemerintah dapat mengawasi dan menindak oknum yang menimbun bahan pangan pokok atau para spekulan yang memainkan harga di pasar ketua KPPU Abdul Rashid Arsyad menyatakan pihaknya telah berusaha mengkonsolidasi para pedagang agar tidak menaikkan harga dengan ekstrim selain dari barang-barang dari agen ataupun pedagang kita akan turunkan harga yang supermurah lagi untuk kita sama-sama stabil harga Jadi jangan sampai adanya virus korona ini jadi kesempatan pedagang ataupun agen-agen dia melonjakkan harganya lebih tinggi Cafe berharap pemerintah melalui Satgas pangan dapat secara aktif masih agar kondisi merubahnya pandemic Vietnam Tin tidak dimanfaatkan oknum tertentu untuk meraup keuntungan dari Jakarta Marcelina Adlin Hai gambar Ehsan
